tile_mapping.coordinate_mapping: Identity for each shared tile, 16 columns by 45 rows.
tile_mapping.address_regression: All tile-local sample slots resolve to the same physical byte offset through both layouts for color and depth; see process2_edram_alias_tile_map_20261028.json.
tile_mapping.format_scope: 32bpp guest EDRAM addressing. The Vulkan source is the renderer's RGBA8_GAMMA representation in its VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UNORM linear-light intermediate, and the destination is its RGBA8_LINEAR VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM target; this is not a raw dump of physical EDRAM bytes.

behavior: Submits the preceding captured draw segment into its persistent 4x Vulkan EDRAM cache target.
Runs a backend-owned fullscreen triangle that unpacks each 1x destination tile-local pixel into its source 4x pixel and MSAA lane, quantizes to 8-bit, and stores into the cached 1x color target.
Submits packet 27 and its immediately following captured Copy/Convert in PM4 order.
implementation.strict_activation: Requires the exact 1280x720, shared-base, 4x/pitch-640 RGBA8_GAMMA to 1x/pitch-1280 RGBA8_LINEAR tuple; 720 identity alias tiles; packet-27 depth/stencil disabled; and an immediately following same-layout sample-zero format-6 copy to 0x0975E000 at 1280x720 with no depth clear.
implementation.depth_stencil: No depth/stencil samples are transferred. The previous 4x depth target remains in its separate cache entry; packet 27 and the associated copy do not use or clear it.
implementation.other_layouts: Unsupported layouts remain fail-closed. The 2560x1440 wrapped layout and format-31 intermediate-copy sequence are not covered by this change.

native_linux.alias_regression: Synthetic source and 1x baseline produce identical full output readbacks through the ordered executor.
native_linux.fail_closed_regression: A pitch-1272 variant is rejected during transition preflight.
